repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/shellcheck-py/shellcheck-py
    rev: v0.11.0.1
    hooks:
      - id: shellcheck

  - repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks
    rev: v5.0.0
    hooks:
      - id: trailing-whitespace
        exclude: ^\.github/actions/artifact/dist/.*\.mjs$
      - id: end-of-file-fixer
        exclude: ^\.github/actions/artifact/dist/.*\.mjs$
      - id: check-yaml
      - id: check-added-large-files
        exclude: ^\.github/actions/artifact/dist/.*\.mjs$
      - id: check-merge-conflict
      - id: check-toml
      - id: debug-statements

  - repo: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit
    rev: v0.8.4
    hooks:
      - id: ruff
        args: [--fix, --exit-non-zero-on-fix]
      - id: ruff-format

  - repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/mirrors-mypy
    rev: v1.13.0
    hooks:
      - id: mypy
        additional_dependencies: [pytest, pytest-asyncio]
        args: [--strict, --ignore-missing-imports]

## Release Notes

Released on 2026-11-12.

### Python

- Add CPython 3.16.0a2 ([#23211](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23211))
- Update managed CPython 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, 3.14, and 3.15 builds to include pip 26.3, zlib 1.4, and Expat 2.10.0 ([#23211](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23211))
- Update GraalPy 3.13.0 to build 25.5.5 ([#23088](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23088))

### Preview features

- Install wheel variants from local paths, direct URLs, and Git repositories in platform-specific resolutions ([#22720](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22720), [#22722](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22722), [#22724](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22724))
- Detect x86-64 microarchitecture levels and AArch64 architecture versions when selecting wheel variants ([#22832](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22832), [#22949](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22949))
- Detect Google TPUs up when selecting wheel variants ([#23066](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23066), [#23121](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23121))
- Fix CPU detection for wheel variants on macOS with GraalPy ([#23089](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23089))
- Report quarantined packages in `uv audit` when index URLs differ only in redacted query values ([#23129](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23129))

### Performance

- Avoid duplicate environment builds when concurrent `uvx` or `uv run --with` invocations need the same environment ([#23123](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23123))

### Bug fixes

- Restrict Unix plaintext credential files to owner-only permissions ([#23209](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23209))
- Honor per-index `exclude-newer-package` cutoffs during resolution ([#23122](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23122))
- Respect negative extra markers on constraints ([#23144](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23144))
- Resolve dependencies of recursive extras from a scoped override ([#23210](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23210))
- Fix `activate.bat` for Windows virtual environments whose paths contain apostrophes ([#23152](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23152))

### Documentation

- Document the shell requirement for GitLab CI job images ([#23078](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23078))

## Install uv 0.13.8

### Install prebuilt binaries via shell script

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://releases.astral.sh/github/uv/releases/download/0.13.8/uv-installer.sh | sh
```

### Install prebuilt binaries via powershell script

```sh
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c "irm https://releases.astral.sh/github/uv/releases/download/0.13.8/uv-installer.ps1 | iex"
```

- Support the [`timezone` configuration in `on.schedule`](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/workflow-syntax#onschedule) with checks for IANA timezone string. See the [documentation](https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/blob/main/docs/checks.md#check-cron-syntax-and-timezone) for more details. Note that actionlint starts to embed the timezone database in the executables from this version so the binary sizes slightly increase. (#641, thanks @martincostello)
  ```yaml
  on:
    schedule:
      # ERROR: The timezone is not a valid IANA timezone string
      - cron: '*/5 * * * *'
        timezone: 'Asia/Somewhere'
  ```
- Support the [`jobs.<job_name>.environment.deployment` configuration](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/how-tos/deploy/configure-and-manage-deployments/control-deployments#using-environments-without-deployments). (#639, thanks @springmeyer)
- Support the [`macos-26-intel` runner label](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-02-26-macos-26-is-now-generally-available-for-github-hosted-runners/). (#629, thanks @hugovk)
- Fix the outdated [table of webhook activity types](https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/blob/main/all_webhooks.go) by rebuilding the [script to scrape the table](https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/tree/main/scripts/generate-webhook-events) from scratch.
- Support Go 1.26 and drop the support for Go 1.24. Now supported versions are 1.25 and 1.26.
- Tests are run on arm64 Windows in CI.
- Update the popular actions data set to the latest.

[Sponsorship is appreciated!](https://github.com/sponsors/woodruffw/)

## New Features 🌈[🔗](https://docs.zizmor.sh/release-notes/#new-features)

- zizmor now has experimental support for GitHub Actions workflow lockfiles. Please see [the limitations documentation](https://docs.zizmor.sh/usage/#workflow-lockfiles) for more information about the current implementation and its limitations ([#2463](https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2463))

## Enhancements 🌱[🔗](https://docs.zizmor.sh/release-notes/#enhancements)

- zizmor's input collection is now "root-aware" by default, meaning that invocations like zizmor . will no longer collect inputs unless they would actually be used by GitHub Actions, etc. This should eliminate spurious findings from (e.g.) workflow definitions in vendored directories. See the [input collection](https://docs.zizmor.sh/usage/#input-collection) documentation for more information. ([#2454](https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2454))

- zizmor's LSP now honors the didChangeWorkspaceFolders event ([#2461](https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2461))

- zizmor's LSP now audits pre-commit inputs ([#2485](https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2485))

- zizmor now provides Windows ARM64 wheels on PyPI ([#2424](https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2424))

    Many thanks to [@ndabas](https://github.com/ndabas) for proposing and implementing this improvement!

## Bug Fixes 🐛[🔗](https://docs.zizmor.sh/release-notes/#bug-fixes)

- Fixed a bug where the [bot-conditions](https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#bot-conditions) audit did not properly flag if: condition of jobs that call a reusable workflow ([#2457](https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2457))

- Fixed a bug where the [obfuscation](https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#obfuscation) audit would incorrectly flag (and suggest an incorrect auto-fix for) expressions that constant-reduce to other expressions ([#2483](https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2483))

- Fixed a bug where the [template-injection](https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#template-injection) audit did not flag attacker-controllable contexts wrapped in fromJSON(...), such as fromJSON(toJSON(github.event.issue.title)) ([#2495](https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2495))

- Fixed a bug where the [template-injection](https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#template-injection) audit did not flag attacker-controllable contexts in the values of case(...), such as case(cond, github.event.issue.title, 'x') ([#2504](https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2504))

- Fixed a class of bugs in the [obfuscation](https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#obfuscation) audit where a constant-reducible subexpression would not be replaced with a contextually correct form ([#2483](https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2483))

- Fixed a bug where zizmor would incorrectly audit pre-commit inputs that ended with .yml, despite pre-commit requiring the .yaml suffix ([#2485](https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2485))

- Fixed a bug where zizmor would not honor some ignore comments for the [stale-action-refs](https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#stale-action-refs) audit ([#2494](https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2494))

- Fixed a bug where zizmor would not honor some ignore comments for the [ref-version-mismatch](https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#ref-version-mismatch) audit ([#2494](https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/issues/2494))
